sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 9B is the model from DeepReinforce's new Ornith 1.5 family that you can actually run locally: a dense 9B multimodal coding model that fits on an 8 GB GPU or a 16 GB Mac at 4-bit quantization. This guide covers our Atomic Dynamic GGUF builds, how much memory each one needs, and the exact setup for both Atomic Chat and llama.cpp.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B: Benchmarks, Pricing & Context Window — Benchgen
sources.snippet: Despite its compact size, Ornith-1.5-9B "delivers remarkably strong results," per the official model card, achieving 47.0% on Terminal Bench 2.1 (Claude Code harness) and 70.6% on SWE-bench Verified — matching or exceeding much larger models such as Gemma 4-31B and Qwen 3.6-35B. It supports a 262,144-token context window, extensible to roughly 1,000,000 tokens via YaRN RoPE scaling.
